How it works

Type it the way you’d say it.

One line adds a class to every day it repeats. Leave the time out and it goes in your next free slot. Add “this week” for a one-off.

  1. Maths Mon Wed 8–9 room 4
    • Maths
    • Mon Wed
    • 08:00–09:00
    • Room 4
  2. Football Tue Thu 4–5:30pm at the field
    • Football
    • Tue Thu
    • 16:00–17:30
    • The field
  3. Maths test Thu 10am this week
    • Maths test
    • Only Thu 5 Nov
    • 10:00–10:40
Styles

Pick a style, then the colours.

Each style changes the type, the shape of each class and the lines. Every style works with Paper, Midnight, Kente and Chalkboard colours.

Saving

Keep it, with or without an NGG account.

Your timetable stays in this browser until you save it.

I’m an NGG member
  • It shows on your member dashboard.
  • Your parent or guardian sees it in the family app.
  • If your centre changes a session, you’re asked before anything changes here.
Sign in with your member ID or email and a one-time code.
I’m not a member
  • We email you a link to your timetable.
  • Open it on any phone or computer to keep editing.
  • No membership needed.
